en.title: Eleanor Coppola's 'Making Marie Antoinette' Documentary Finally Arrives
en.summary: A captivating look behind the scenes of Sofia Coppola's iconic film 'Marie Antoinette' is set to be released. Directed by the late Eleanor Coppola, the documentary offers an intimate glimpse into the making of a modern cinematic masterpiece.
en.body:
The world of cinema is abuzz with the imminent release of **Making Marie Antoinette**, a documentary that grants us an unprecedented look at the creation of **Sofia Coppola**'s visually stunning 2006 film, *Marie Antoinette*. This behind-the-scenes journey is helmed by the acclaimed documentarian **Eleanor Coppola**, the director's mother, who captured over eighty hours of footage during the production at the Palace of Versailles. The film, acquired by MUBI for worldwide distribution, is a poignant posthumous release, with **Eleanor Coppola** having passed away in 2024.

Shot during the ambitious 2005 production, **Making Marie Antoinette** delves into the intricate craftsmanship that defined **Sofia Coppola**'s third feature. Viewers will witness the meticulous work of legendary costume designer **Milena Canonero** and gain insight into the challenges and triumphs of being a young female director navigating the opulent, historically significant setting of Versailles, a location rarely granted to filmmakers. **Sofia Coppola** herself completed the editing of her mother's extensive footage to mark the 20th anniversary of *Marie Antoinette* and to honor her mother's vision, ensuring this intimate perspective would finally be shared.

## A Mother's Lens on Her Daughter's Vision

The documentary promises a fascinating exploration of the filmmaking process, focusing on **Sofia Coppola**'s unique directorial approach and the collaborative spirit on set. It captures the essence of bringing a historical figure to life with a contemporary sensibility, a hallmark of **Sofia Coppola**'s work. The initial synopsis highlights "the craftsmanship that went into the film, legendary costume designer **Milena Canonero** at work and what it was like to be a young female director at that time." This offers a dual perspective: the artistic endeavor of making *Marie Antoinette* and the personal journey of **Eleanor Coppola** documenting her daughter's significant cinematic achievement.

## For the Passionate Fanbase

For the devoted fans of both **Sofia Coppola** and **Eleanor Coppola**, this documentary is an absolute must-see. It’s not just about seeing how a beloved film was made; it’s about witnessing a unique mother-daughter collaboration unfold. The film offers a rare, intimate look at a director at work, filtered through the loving, observant eye of another accomplished filmmaker. Given **Sofia Coppola**'s recent projects and the enduring legacy of *Marie Antoinette*, this release taps directly into the community's deep appreciation for her distinct cinematic voice and the artistry behind her most iconic works.

## What's Next

**Making Marie Antoinette** is slated for release in 2026, with MUBI handling worldwide rights. Further details regarding specific release dates and platforms are expected to be announced soon.

tr.title: Eleanor Coppola'nın 'Marie Antoinette'nin Yapımı' Belgeseli Nihayet Geliyor
tr.summary: Sofia Coppola'nın ikonik filmi 'Marie Antoinette'nin ardında kalanları keşfeden bir belgesel yakında yayınlanacak. Eleanor Coppola'nın yönettiği bu belgesel, modern bir sinema şaheserinin yapımına dair samimi bir bakış sunuyor.
tr.body:
Sinema dünyası, **Making Marie Antoinette** adlı bir belgeselin yakında yayınlanacağı haberleriyle çalkalanıyor. Bu belgesel, **Sofia Coppola**'nın 2006 yapımı görsel şöleni *Marie Antoinette*'nin yaratılışına dair hiç görülmemiş bir bakış sunuyor. Ünlü belgeselci **Eleanor Coppola**, yani Sofia'nın annesi, Versailles Sarayı'ndaki çekimlerde 80 saatten fazla görüntü kaydetmiş. MUBI tarafından dünya genelinde dağıtımı yapılacak bu film, **Eleanor Coppola**'nın 2024 yılında vefat etmesi之后 poignan bir yayın olacak.

 2005 yılındaki iddialı prodüksiyonda çekilen **Making Marie Antoinette**, **Sofia Coppola**'nın üçüncü uzun metrajlı filmine dair detaylı bir içerik sunuyor. İzleyiciler, efsanevi kostüm tasarımcısı **Milena Canonero**'nun titiz çalışmalarına tanıklık edecek ve Versailles'in ihtişamlı, tarihi ortamında genç bir kadın yönetmenin karşılaştığı zorlukları ve başarıları görecekler. **Sofia Coppola**, annesinin geniş kapsamlı görüntülerini *Marie Antoinette*'in 20. yılı için düzenleyerek, annesinin vizyonunu onurlandırarak bu samimi bakış açısını nihayet paylaşmış oldu.

 ## Bir Annenin Kızı'nın Vizyonuna Bakış
 Bu belgesel, sinema yapım sürecine dair bir keşif vaat ediyor; **Sofia Coppola**'nın benzersiz yönetmenlik yaklaşımına ve setteki işbirliği ruhuna odaklanıyor. Tarihsel bir figürü çağdaş bir duyarlılıkla canlandırma konusundaki çalışmayı yakından izleyeceğiz; bu da **Sofia Coppola**'nın işinin önemli bir yönü. İlk tanıtımda vurgulanan 'filmin yapımındaki zanaat, efsanevi kostüm tasarımcısı **Milena Canonero**'nun çalışması ve o dönemde genç bir kadın yönetmen olmak' iki farklı perspektifi sunuyor: *Marie Antoinette*'in sanatsal girişimi ve **Eleanor Coppola**'nın kızı'nın önemli sinema başarılarını belgeleme yolculuğu.

 ## Tutkulu Hayran Kitlesi İçin
 Hem **Sofia Coppola** hem de **Eleanor Coppola**'nın sadık hayranları için bu belgesel, kaçırılmaması gereken bir fırsat. Sadece bir film nasıl yapıldığını görmek değil, aynı zamanda benzersiz bir anne-kız işbirliğini izlemek söz konusu. Film, bir yönetmenin çalışma sürecine dair nadir, samimi bir bakış sunuyor; bütün bunlar, başka bir yetenekli film yapımcısının sevgi dolu, gözlemci gözünden geçiyor. **Sofia Coppola**'nın recent projeleri ve *Marie Antoinette*'in kalıcı mirası düşünüldüğünde, bu yayın, topluluğun ona duyduğu derin takdiri ve onun en ikonik eserlerinin ardındaki sanatsal vizyonu doğrudan hedef alıyor.

 ## Sonraki Adımlar
 **Making Marie Antoinette**, 2026 yılında MUBI tarafından dünya genelinde dağıtılacak. Specific yayın tarihleri ve platformlar hakkında daha fazla ayrıntı yakında açıklanacak.

content_raw: After Priscilla and her recent documentary Marc by Sofia , we’ve been waiting to see what Sofia Coppola will tackle next, following news that plans were scrapped for a reunion with Kirsten Dunst. In the meantime, a new look at the making of one of her greatest films has now finally been completed. MUBI has acquired worldwide rights for Making Marie Antoinette , directed by Eleanor Coppola (who passed away in 2024) and produced by Sofia Coppola. With news breaking a few years ago on the project, the exclusive behind-the-scenes look at Sofia Coppola’s Oscar-winning Marie Antoinette was shot by her mother Eleanor Coppola, and produced by Lorenzo Mieli, Mario Gianani, Rachel Dengiz, Youree Henley, and Sofia Coppola. The footage was edited by Aaron Matthews with input from Eleanor’s good friends Davia Nelson and Liz Bird. The film was financed by OUR FILMS (A Mediawan Company), Mediawan Rights, and Entourage Pictures. Here’s the synopsis: “In 2005, Sofia Coppola made her third feature film, Marie Antoinette , starring Kirsten Dunst and Jason Schwartzman, at the Palace of Versailles, the first production ever to have been granted permission. Her mother, acclaimed documentarian Eleanor Coppola, accompanied her on set and shot about eighty hours of footage, focusing on her daughter’s journey of making the film. This year, to mark the 20th anniversary of the release of Marie Antoinette , and to fulfil her mother’s wishes, Coppola edited the unseen footage.  Making Marie Antoinette  shows the craftsmanship that went into the film, legendary costume designer Milena Canonero at work and what it was like to be a young female director at that time. The result is a fascinating look at the process of making this landmark film, and an unexpectedly intimate family portrait. In the film, Eleanor Coppola is voiced by Academy Award® nominee Diane Lane, who reads passages from Eleanor’s journals in which she discusses her experiences on set and reflects on her relationship with her daughter.” Photo by Andrew Durham Efe Cakarel, MUBI’s Founder and CEO said, “Sofia is one of the defining filmmakers of her generation, with a voice and sensibility entirely her own. Marie Antoinette was bold, beautiful, irreverent and hugely influential, and to revisit it now through Eleanor Coppola’s eyes, as both a filmmaker and a mother, is incredibly moving. We are proud to bring this intimate and remarkable portrait to audiences around the world.” Sofia Coppola said:, “My mother and I started going through her footage during lockdown. It was always her wish to make what she shot into a feature length documentary. She was on set as a filmmaker and also my mother, so I found it so moving to go back through the material and to see our shoot through her eyes.
